content.en: The **Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)** is a specialized agency of the United Nations. Its primary objective is to achieve **food security** for all and ensure that people have regular access to enough high-quality food to lead active, healthy lives. It acts as a neutral forum where nations meet to negotiate agreements and debate policy.

definition.en: FAO serves as a knowledge network, providing data and technical expertise to member countries.

content.en: Focuses on the availability, access, utilization, and stability of food supplies.
content.hi: Focuses on the availability, access, utilization, and stability of food supplies.

content.en: Do not confuse FAO with the World Food Programme (WFP); while they collaborate, FAO focuses on policy and technical support, whereas WFP focuses on emergency food assistance.

content.en: Focus on FAO's reports like 'The State of Food and Agriculture' as they often contain data relevant to Indian economic policy.
